title: Scam operations: Online fraud networks
summary: OpenAI banned accounts tied to online fraud networks using AI to support scam scripts, impersonation, translation, and victim engagement.
body: OpenAI banned accounts tied to online fraud networks using AI to support scam scripts, impersonation, translation, and victim engagement.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了参与在线诈骗网络的账户，这些账户利用AI支持欺诈脚本编写、身份冒充、跨语言翻译及受害者互动，以扩大诈骗规模。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned accounts tied to online fraud networks using AI to support scam scripts, impersonation, translation, and victim engagement.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Scam operations: Online fraud networks”。其重要性主要体现在：记录了诈骗网络利用AI进行跨语言身份冒充和欺诈活动的行业安全动态。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
